privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: Great Sport Bets collects minimal personal information necessary for account creation and premium access, including email addresses and payment details processed securely via Stripe (web) and Google Play / RevenueCat (Android).
privacy.s2Body: We use your information to provide access to our betting tips, process payments, and manage the referral system. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.s3Body: We implement industry-standard security measures via Supabase, Stripe, Google Play and RevenueCat to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the Internet is 100% secure.
privacy.s4Body: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at greatsportbets@gmail.com.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: Great Sport Bets provides informational betting tips and surebets. We do not provide gambling services or financial advice. All betting activities are at your own risk.
terms.s2Body: Premium access is provided via subscriptions on Android (Google Play, processed through RevenueCat) and one-time purchases on the web (processed through Stripe). Google Play subscriptions are subject to Google Play's payment and refund policies. Web purchases are final once access has been granted.
terms.s3Body: Our referral system is intended for personal use. Abuse, including self-referral or fraudulent account creation, will result in account suspension and loss of bonuses.
terms.s4Body: Great Sport Bets does not guarantee winnings. Past performance is not indicative of future results. Always gamble responsibly.

deletion.title: Account & Data Deletion
deletion.intro: At Great Sport Bets, we respect your privacy and provide a clear path to delete your account and personal data.
deletion.warningBody: Deleting your account is permanent. You will lose access to your Premium status, referral bonuses, and history. This action cannot be undone.
deletion.step1: Send an email to <email>{{email}}</email> from the email address associated with your Great Sport Bets account.
deletion.step2: Include "Account Deletion Request" in the subject line.
deletion.step3: Your request will be processed within 7 business days. You will receive a confirmation email once the deletion is complete.
deletion.deleted2: Premium access records and payment history
deletion.keptBody: For legal and financial compliance (e.g., tax reporting for Stripe and Google Play payments), we may retain transaction IDs and metadata for up to 5 years. This data is disconnected from your personal identity and used only for auditing.
